full_judgment: PW12 Md. Jamal Uddin is a man of 27/28 years of age who stated that he knew the  informant and also the accused Alamgir. On 05.8.2002 at about quarter to 8 pm while he was going from Katakhali of Moriumnagar by a bus as a member of the bridal party and stopped at the gate of the Rangunia College for buying flower garland, suddenly a man entered into the bus and sat down on the door holding his head downward. The witness along with others asked him why he entered into the bus and what happened to him and at this he replied that his face has been burnt. The witness along with others inquired as to how the man got burnt and the man replied that he got burning injuries by water of battery. They wanted to drop the man out of the bridal party bus but he refused and at this state some members of the bridal party said that they knew the man. He is an employee of Kader Mike service. The man said that he will go to Isakhali Health Complex. He was thus carried to Isakhali but the man refused to get down from the said bus and said that he will go to the Chittagong Medical College Hospital. Since his conduct appeared suspicious, they dropped him out of the bus. Next morning, the witness came to learn that the said man, i-e, accused Alamgir threw acid on Hasan Murad of Maizpara that night and he himself was also injured by acid. This witness identified the accused Alamgir on the dock.
